code_paths.note: Research scripts kept verbatim in tools/. Operational adapters: server_catalog_decoder.py (bridge run()) and file_decoder.py (engine CLI).

connection_authentication.note: No HMAC observed in the catalog envelope, the .rj/.js update blob, or the .ovpn import path. The envelope uses AES-256-CBC with PKCS7 padding and no MAC; field values use XXTEA with no MAC. No evidence was found that any HMAC authenticates a VPN connection; no live login or connection was attempted. The absence claim covers only the code paths reviewed (catalog fetch, offline update, .ovpn import).
